source.name: Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act Database
source.description: Federal lobbying registrations and lobbyist contribution reports via lda.senate.gov/api

note: Senate LDA open API does not key lobbying-contact filings to individual members (government_entities=SENATE only). Scanned 29 contribution-report pages (725 filings, years 2026,2025,2024,2023, name-search + chronological) for lobbyist FECA items with honoree matching Bernard Sanders; 0 matches.
